Author: Petra105
Name: PvP TopPlates
Description:
Draws stabilized PvP player HP, shield, MP, and Guard-state indicators in Dalamud's foreground UI layer so terrain and map geometry cannot cover them.

Use /ptop to configure.
Punchline: Keeps PvP resources and Guard state above the 3D world.
Changelog: Changes the plugin author attribution to Petra105.
